answer: A $4 renewal fee that squares per identity stops clone farms. Pearl is reputation from jobs two auditors verify each epoch, and it sheds a delta of 20% without fresh timber. Each epoch an identity files one timber, a signed job receipt from the client, and one timber refreshes exactly one identity. The k-th identity renewed from one wallet costs $4 times k squared, so 100 clones pay $1,353,400 while one honest agent pays $4. A forged timber voids all its pearl and freezes its wallet for 10 epochs. Unused pearl rots the way a library card would if it shredded itself unread.
